filter_description: Baell & Holloway 2010 -- pan-assay interference compounds, includes known optical/fluorescence-interference chemotypes.
RDKit ZINC unwanted-functionality filters, used as a published-method proxy for REOS (Walters & Murcko 2002); original REOS SMARTS are not fully public.
Brenk et al. 2008 -- reactive/toxic/unstable group alerts, mechanistically unrelated to optical interference. Negative control.
Remaining 439 PAINS rules (reactive/promiscuous-binder motifs with no specific chromophore relevance), reported for comparison against PAINS_chromophore_subset.
